summary: The base reproducibly destroys enabled sync and async trace contexts at an uninitialized pickle relay. The exact candidate preserves the opaque wire state across such relays and reconstructs an enabled context at the initialized destination. Production source confirms the multi-tokenizer and multi-detokenizer routers exercise this transparent pickle receive/send boundary. Candidate regressions and independent three-hop, final-reconstruction, and disabled-context cases passed.

No native source changed, so rebuilding native code was not applicable.
